note: Creative translation table, not a measured mapping. The Ten Gods are treated as a vocabulary of relationships around the self; each one becomes a want, the cost that comes with it, and the thing that breaks the character. Masks say how a god shows up in each of four settings. Written in English first; zh/ja later.

companion.name: The Peer
companion.want: To stand on equal footing and owe nobody.
companion.cost: Turns down help even when drowning; treats every favor as a debt.
companion.break: Being made dependent — stripped of the ability to do it alone.

rob_wealth.name: The Rival
rob_wealth.want: To win — especially against someone just like them.
rob_wealth.cost: Competes with the people closest to them; can't let a small loss go.
rob_wealth.break: Losing publicly to someone they considered an equal.

eating_god.name: The Artist
eating_god.want: To make things and enjoy them at an unhurried pace.
eating_god.cost: Drifts away from conflict and deadlines; comfort becomes avoidance.
eating_god.break: Being forced into a life with no room to make anything of their own.

hurting_officer.name: The Rebel
hurting_officer.want: To be brilliant and say the true thing out loud.
hurting_officer.cost: Cuts people with the truth; picks fights with any authority.
hurting_officer.break: Being silenced — or having their talent dismissed by someone with power.

indirect_wealth.name: The Adventurer
indirect_wealth.want: Big chances, wide circles, money that moves.
indirect_wealth.cost: Spreads attention thin; promises more than they can keep.
indirect_wealth.break: A gamble that fails and takes their reputation for generosity with it.

direct_wealth.name: The Provider
direct_wealth.want: Steady ground: earned money, kept promises, a home that holds.
direct_wealth.cost: Counts everything; love starts to look like an account book.
direct_wealth.break: Losing what they built slowly to something they couldn't control.

seven_killings.name: The Warrior
seven_killings.want: To face the threat head-on and come out in command.
seven_killings.cost: Lives on alert; meets tenderness as if it were an attack.
seven_killings.break: Being cornered with no fight possible — helpless in front of others.

direct_officer.name: The Guardian
direct_officer.want: To be trusted, to do it right, to have a place in the order of things.
direct_officer.cost: Swallows disagreement to stay approved; rules become a hiding place.
direct_officer.break: Public disgrace — the title or the trust taken away.

indirect_resource.name: The Mystic
indirect_resource.want: To understand what others miss, on their own odd terms.
indirect_resource.cost: Withdraws, distrusts warmth, and lets suspicion do the talking.
indirect_resource.break: Being made ordinary and readable — their inner world laughed at.

direct_resource.name: The Nurturer
direct_resource.want: To be cared for — and to care, protect and teach.
direct_resource.cost: Waits to be chosen; can mistake being needed for being loved.
direct_resource.break: The person or place that made them feel safe disappears.

lines.companion: With strangers: friendly but even-handed — nobody gets special treatment, including them.
lines.rob_wealth: With strangers: quick to joke, quicker to compare; sizes up who's ahead.
lines.eating_god: With strangers: easygoing and generous with food, jokes and time.
lines.hurting_officer: With strangers: sharp, funny, a little too honest for first meetings.
lines.indirect_wealth: With strangers: the life of the room — remembers names, picks up the tab.
lines.direct_wealth: With strangers: polite, practical, notices who pays and who doesn't.
lines.seven_killings: With strangers: guarded and intense; people sense they shouldn't push.
lines.direct_officer: With strangers: correct, composed, and careful about appearances.
lines.indirect_resource: With strangers: hard to read; answers questions with questions.
lines.direct_resource: With strangers: gentle and attentive — the one who asks if you've eaten.

lines.companion: At work: self-reliant; would rather redo it alone than delegate.
lines.rob_wealth: At work: competitive and fast; treats colleagues as a scoreboard.
lines.eating_god: At work: craft over speed; does beautiful work on their own schedule.
lines.hurting_officer: At work: innovative and insubordinate; fixes what they were told not to touch.
lines.indirect_wealth: At work: a dealmaker; juggles five opportunities and drops one.
lines.direct_wealth: At work: dependable, thorough, keeps the books straight.
lines.seven_killings: At work: thrives in crisis; takes command when things go wrong.
lines.direct_officer: At work: follows procedure, earns trust, rises through the proper channels.
lines.indirect_resource: At work: a specialist; brilliant at the strange problem nobody else wants.
lines.direct_resource: At work: the mentor; makes the team safer and slower.

lines.companion: In private: needs their own space even in love; affection given as equals.
lines.rob_wealth: In private: possessive and playful; jealousy shows up as teasing.
lines.eating_god: In private: soft, sensual, happiest cooking for someone at home.
lines.hurting_officer: In private: emotionally vivid; argues to feel close.
lines.indirect_wealth: In private: romantic in bursts, then distracted; loves the chase.
lines.direct_wealth: In private: loyal and steady; shows love through doing things for you.
lines.seven_killings: In private: fiercely protective; vulnerability arrives only after a fight.
lines.direct_officer: In private: proper even when close; feelings expressed through responsibility.
lines.indirect_resource: In private: lets very few in; once in, you see a whole hidden world.
lines.direct_resource: In private: wants to be held and to hold; remembers every small kindness.

inner_drive.label: Inner drive
inner_drive.zh: 时柱 · 心里真正想要的

lines.companion: Deep down: to prove they never needed anyone — and to be wrong about that.
lines.rob_wealth: Deep down: to be chosen over the rival, just once, without asking.
lines.eating_god: Deep down: a quiet life that is entirely their own.
lines.hurting_officer: Deep down: to be recognized as exceptional by someone who matters.
lines.indirect_wealth: Deep down: freedom — never being tied to one place or one fate.
lines.direct_wealth: Deep down: security for the people they love, measured and guaranteed.
lines.seven_killings: Deep down: to never be powerless again.
lines.direct_officer: Deep down: an honorable name that outlives them.
lines.indirect_resource: Deep down: to understand why — about themselves most of all.
lines.direct_resource: Deep down: a home where they are wanted without having to earn it.

strength.strong: Self-driven: pushes outward, resists being steered.
strength.balanced: Adaptive: bends with the situation without losing the thread.
strength.weak: Relational: draws strength from the people and structures around them.

mbtiRule: Axis score = 0.5 + sum(god weight x god mbti delta), clamped to [0.05, 0.95]. Positive EI leans I, positive NS leans S, positive TF leans T, positive JP leans P. Type probability = product of the four axis probabilities; report the top 3 renormalized to sum to 1. Output prior only, never an input.
